data.name: From Dumplings to Dim Sum
data.headline: Explore the Flavors & Culture of Boston's Chinatown
data.description:
#Sample traditional and modern Chinese cuisine in Boston's beloved Chinatown neighborhood.

*Boston’s Chinatown is a small neighborhood with big history and delicious eats. Come explore the best of traditional and modern day Chinese dishes, and the fascinating stories  behind this culture-filled neighborhood.*
data.cancellation_notes:
**For Non-Refundable Tickets:** All sales are final - no refunds or exchanges.

**For Refundable Tickets:** At least 48 hours notice is required in order to receive a refund. Tickets canceled less than 48 hours prior to the tour start time will not be refunded or rescheduled. Late arrivals and / or No-shows will also not be refunded or rescheduled. Thank you for your cooperation.

*PLEASE CHECK YOUR EVENT DATE CAREFULLY BEFORE BOOKING.*

This experience was created as an adult activity. **We kindly ask that all guests joining our tour be at least 12 years of age.** This activity is not appropriate to attend with infants or toddlers, and strollers are not permitted on any of our tours.

Due to agreements in place with our partner restaurants, there is a maximum guest capacity per tour. **EVERY participant must have a ticket to join the tour.**
data.booking_notes:
#Meeting Place

##China Pearl Restaurant

**9 Tyler Street**
**Boston, MA 02111**

****Please meet your guide right by the entrance on the street level***

*China Pearl is an easy 5-minute walk (0.2mi) from either the Chinatown stop (Orange Line) or 8-minute walk (0.3mi) from South Station (Red Line) via the T (subway).*
___________________________________
## Important Details / What to Bring

* Please arrive **at least 10 minutes early to check in.** Our tours start right on time.
* Please **bring a bottled water** along if you'd like for the walking portion of the tour. Beverages may not included with all food tastings.
* If you are consuming alcohol, please bring your **driver's license or passport!**
* Gratuity for your tour guide is *not included in your ticket price*. While not mandatory, if you enjoy yourself and would like to consider a tip for your tour guide, **gratuities are greatly appreciated and graciously accepted at the end of the tour.** *If you have already included gratuity in your booking, it will be passed on to your guide. Thank You!*
* This tour takes place rain or shine and New England weather can be unpredictable, so please check the weather and temperature on the day of your tour and **dress for the forecast**. We have fun in all types of weather, and being prepared for the elements will go a long way in making the most of your tour experience!
* Please **wear comfortable clothes and walking shoes**. We will be outdoors and on our feet for most of the tour, and we want you to be as comfortable as possible.
* Feel free to **bring a camera**, Boston is beautiful and taking photos is both welcomed encouraged!
___________________________________
## Parking

Meters in Boston have a 2-hour limit per block, which is not enough time to cover the full length of the tour. We recommend arriving via public transportation when possible, or parking in a lot. There is much open air and covered lots within walking distance of the meeting location. You can use " Chinatown Gate" as a location when searching maps for nearby parking structures.
___________________________________
## Other FAQs

**How much food can I expect to eat during the tour?**
We provide tastings, so please do not expect a full meal at each location. Tastings vary in portion size, with some tastings served while seated inside the restaurant, and others served in a more “on the go” manner to also allow time for the neighborhood component of the tour.

**Can children participate in the tour? What about toddlers and strollers?**
Children ages 12 and older are welcome to participate. This activity is not appropriate to attend with infants and, due to space limitations, strollers are not permitted on any of our tours.

**Are restrooms available during the tour?**
Restrooms will be available at the beginning and end of the tour at the corresponding tasting locations.

## See You Soon,
# Bites of Boston
